_doc: EXP-0207 proposed verdicts, recomputed from raw/ by analysis/verdicts.py under PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 6 as superseded by RE_EXPERIMENT_PROCESS_CORRECTIONS.md (six independent axes; Gates A/B/C/E; exact numerators and denominators, never a percentage alone). Hard outcomes are counted SEPARATELY from distinct valid payloads. Liveness is NOT rounded up into a semantic or emitter label.

dev_scoreboard_fence.db_says: 'The compiler inserts it around divergent control flow and before atomics/calls.'
dev_scoreboard_fence.measured_on_G17P: two carriers built precisely for that description -- divergent device atomics plus threadgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_device) -- emit ZERO occurrences. They emit the 0x07 `scoreboard_fence` sibling instead (07 02 00 00 before the atomics, 07 22 02 00, 07 42 02 00). Splicing that occurrence's byte0 0x07 -> 0x80 produces a legal, cleanly-executing dev_scoreboard_fence, and all 256 scope_flag values then run without fault. Reproduces EXP-0141's finding on a much stronger carrier.
dev_scoreboard_fence.status: CANDIDATE -- the 'compiler inserts it' clause is unsupported by any own-MSL carrier we can build

get_sr.dst_hi.candidate_correction: byte+3 bits 5-7 are NOT the destination-register extension on G17P; the bank appears to live in byte+2. Bounded to: the compiled dst values on these five carriers, dst_hi 0..7.
get_sr.dst_hi.db_says: semantics: 'The full destination register is dst = byte0[4:8] | (byte+3[5:8] << 4), reaching r0..r127 -- dst_hi (byte+3 bits5-7) is the register EXTENSION.'
get_sr.dst_hi.measured_on_G17P: INERT across 8 of 8 values on FIVE arms in TWO stages (compute sr_c/sr_dump/sr_hi, fragment sr_f/sr_f2), two gated runs in opposite case order, 100% per-value agreement, with the in-dimension control firing on every arm: splicing `dst` (the LOW half of the same register number) moves the observable, and on the register-dump carrier it clobbers a NAMED codeword slot (slot 9 at dst=10), so a relocated write IS visible to this read-back plan. Relocating `dst_hi` clobbers nothing and changes nothing. What does move the destination bank is `dp_width` (byte+2): the documented 0x50 'top dst bank' ladder step moves the observable and clobbers codeword slot 8.
get_sr.dst_hi.status: CANDIDATE -- not applied; db.json is the orchestrator's file

get_sr.form.candidate_correction: `form` is not merely a width modifier: it gates whether the system-value read happens at all, under dp_width 0x14/0x15. Bounded to dp_width in {0x00,0x04,0x10,0x11,0x14,0x15,0x50,0x54} x form in {0,1} on six carriers.
get_sr.form.db_says: semantics: 'bit3 (form) is a datapath/width modifier (set for the position-in-grid SR family) that does not change the SR select.'
get_sr.form.measured_on_G17P: form is a READ-ENABLE whose effect is CONDITIONAL on dp_width. At dp_width 0x10 it is inert on all six arms; at dp_width 0x14 it changes the output on all five compute/fragment arms -- INCLUDING the four whose compiler-chosen dp_width was 0x10, so the effect follows the FIELD, not the carrier. With dp_width 0x14, form=1 makes the read contribute exactly zero: out(form=1) == out(form=0) - lane*65536 for all 64 lanes on sr_hi, and the 18-selector map collapses from 6 distinct payloads to 1.

get_sr.sr_sel[168].candidate_correction: 168 reads a GRID SIZE IN THREADS (threads_per_grid.x) rather than a threadgroup count, at least under a non-uniform dispatchThreads dispatch.
get_sr.sr_sel[168].measured_on_G17P: under dispatchThreads(64) with threadsPerThreadgroup(64) -- ONE threadgroup -- selector 168 returns 64 on both compute arms and in both gated runs, the same value selector 152 (threads_per_threadgroup.x) returns, where the documented reading predicts 1. Selectors 169/170 return 1, which both readings predict. This is the ONLY selector where the host oracle was refuted, and it was refuted identically at form=0 and form=1.
get_sr.sr_sel[168].status: CANDIDATE -- not applied; one dispatch shape tested

mesh_out_src.sel.db_says: validation.json label 'tokenization-only -- framing only (round-trips; no value semantics established)'
mesh_out_src.sel.measured_on_G17P: first dispatch ever: 129 of 256 values SUPPRESS THE DRAW entirely and 127 run legally, identically, on the one carrier that emits the op. The field is therefore not free framing. NOTE: this arm is CARRIER-UNDECIDABLE -- no control could move its frame to a different VALID payload -- so the 127-value inertness is NOT a finding, only the 129-value hazard map is.
